method: Passive recorded-state accounting and independent Cycle 15 identity/admission calculations. No simulator imports, applied actions, matches or counterfactual continuations.

opponent_terminal.qualification: Reference arithmetic only; no routing or price-impact-adjusted sale proceeds are claimed. Immature crops cannot be harvested before the recorded terminal state.

limitations: Raw market quantities are requests, not independently reconciled sale fills; fixed-price acquisitions were reconciled separately from observed stock changes.
The product-receipts cash residual is sales less wheat/fertilizer purchases, not gross revenue.
Duplicate operations exclude legal shared movement and shed transfers; the count is not proof every duplicate was a no-op.
Both private inventories are available for post-game accounting; a live policy may use only its own private inventory and public rival farm state.
Independent source forecasts identify the actual admission mechanism but do not prove a rejected purchase would win a continuation.
No opponent source or model architecture is available.
